biography.plain_text: Pierro Henri Børge Serena Kruse is a Danish fashion and accessories owner-operator. He controls the holding companies behind Ronald and Nümph, businesses spanning jewellery, apparel and international distribution. His association with Ronald stretches back to the company's 1976 incorporation, and he remains on the boards of both operating companies after decades of private-company leadership.

long_biography.plain_text:
By the mid-1990s, Kruse was sales director and a shareholder at Ronald Accessories, a wholesaler of jewellery, sunglasses and fashion goods. He then helped establish a holding vehicle that concentrated his interest in the business. Subsequent operations extended beyond Denmark through distribution subsidiaries and property investments.

The group's most consequential expansion came in 2018, when Ronald's holding company acquired Nümph Holding. That transaction brought three Danish fashion labels—Nümph, And Less and Anerkjendt—into the portfolio and shifted the business further toward apparel. Kruse continues to govern the group through its holding structure while professional executives manage day-to-day operations.
